items.title: SpaceX isn’t the wireless threat that investors fear — unless someone breaks this unspoken agreement
items.description: It would likely be too expensive and time-consuming for SpaceX to build a mobile network on its own. But the major wireless carriers have to hope one of their rivals doesn’t sell out.
